area: Poplar / South Bromley west of the Lea: Chrisp Street, Railway Street beside the North London Railway, South Bromley station, St Michael & All Angels, St Leonard's Avenue, Burcham Street
method: Sweep crops r0c0-r2c2 all displayed and anchored at opening (r0c0 South Bromley Station/RIFLE STREET; r0c1 CHADBOURN/WELLINGTON STREET; r0c2 St Michael & All Angels; r1c0 CORDING/BOWEN STREET, Sack Works; r1c1 RAILWAY STREET, BRIGHT STREET, School; r1c2 Bromley/Dunbar Cottages; r2c0 CARMEN/CHARLES/CORDELIA STREET; r2c1 NORTH LONDON rly, HACK STREET; r2c2 TAPLEY/BURCHAM STREET). Contact sheets c2_A, c2_B, c2_C, c2_D (6x region/candidate), c2_E and c2_F (12x B.M. decimals and pheons), c2_G, c2_H (8x digits), c2_I (8x), c2_J3 (10x smoothed + nearest, 6 vs 0); region views c2_reg1-reg8 (4x) for pheon searches and Railway Street lettering. Every image displayed when opened. Dot centroids by numeric helper; positions checked on a marker sheet.
legibility: clear; horizontal sheet join py ~192 (tint line, full width); F.P. dots and interpunct-like dots in STREET/BURCHAM/KERBEY lettering make several dots ambiguous
